'''Simmin Mandel''' was the son of [[Kvarn Mandel]], the head of [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech, Inc]]. Eleven years after his [[Samire Mandel|sister]] had disappeared, Simmim continued to search for her, even going so far as to hire the [[Skine Bounty Hunter College]] to try to find her.
